newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Hui Shung passes on 54,000T soy/corn tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Hui Shung passes on 54,000T soy/corn tender.

text.p: Taiwan's Hui Shung Group passed on a tender on Thursday for a shipment of 46,000 tonnes of soybeans and 8,000 tonnes of corn, both of U.S. or South American origin, due to high bid prices, traders said.
The lowest soybean bid, specifying South American origin, on Thursday was 171 U.S. cents per tonne over September Chicago futures, or about US$324.5 per tonne, by Continental Grain, traders said.
Lowest U.S. soybean bid for the shipment was Continental's 189 U.S. cents per tonne over September Chicago futures, or about US$331 per tonne, they said.
Bidding prices for corn were not available.
No retender date has been set, traders said.
